第五章 潘森的两级怨念
作者君一大早醒了，发现自己好像被破（和谐）处啦。
感谢书友110501153050989（请叫我开水哥）、难免留个疤、情情情情情丶的打赏，作者君还是第一次哦，\(^o^)/~
科技学院，女生宿舍内。
“清雅姐，你倒是快点啊。”宿舍门口，一位鹅蛋脸，有些婴儿肥，秀丽非常的女孩对着门内大喊道。
“马上来了，青青你等一下。”一道清脆悦耳的声音从门内传来。
“马上马上，都好多马上了。”李青青听后，嘴巴嘟囔道。
“来了来了，那么急做什么。”王清雅仿佛听到李青青小小的抱怨声，微微一笑的捏了捏那有些婴儿肥的可爱脸蛋。
“别捏了，再捏就更肥了。还有你可是说好的，今天要教我玩英雄联盟，可不许嫌我笨。”
“咱们就不能在寝室教吗，反正有电脑，网吧那么乌烟瘴气的，很不干净的。”王清雅有些无奈的揉了揉头，实在有些搞不懂为何自己这个闺蜜非得去网吧玩。
“贴吧上说在网吧玩英雄联盟更有气氛，更有激情。咱们就去嘛。”李青青瞪着纯纯的大眼睛看着王清雅，抱着其手臂嗲声撒娇道。
王清雅听到其嗲声后，直呼受不了。
“好了好了，咱就去吧，不过外面网吧那么多，我们去哪家网吧。”
“嘿嘿，我已经做好调查了，火力全开网吧里环境最好，而且便宜，是一家新开的网吧，咱们就去火力全开吧。”
王清雅拗不过她，只得应道。
刚一来到火力全开网吧，李青青就有些大呼小叫。
“清雅，你看那边有人在玩英雄联盟唉。”
王清雅闻言，有些无语。
要是她是个男的，现在估计已经开口大骂了。
这不是废话吗，现在英雄联盟已经是全球最大的电竞游戏，基本上网吧的都是玩英雄联盟的，极其少有见到别人玩别的游戏的。

不过她也知道，自己这位闺蜜确实是有些心思单纯，平时虽然有些小傲娇，但是却是极其可爱。
看着李青青已经跑到对方后面观看起来，王清雅无奈只得跟上。
走近一看，对方用的是一位上单瑞雯，却是王清雅极其喜欢的上单英雄。
只不过对方有些不妙啊，还没开始游戏，己方就已经开始吵起来了。
看见那个‘五楼上单，不给就送’的字眼，王清雅眼中一阵厌恶。
这种人她也遇到过不少，基本没有一个玩的好的，且经常一有劣势就直接想二十投。
随后王清雅又发现，蓝色方的日女好像也掉了。
也就是说蓝色方的玩家，要面临的是3V5的状态。
“清雅姐，你说他能赢吗？”李青青有些不明所以的问道。
“应该…不能吧。毕竟是一把三打五的局面，这样很难赢的。”王清雅微微犹豫，还是小声的说道。
毕竟这种当着别人的面议论他，是非常不好的。
“青青我们走吧，你不是要让我教你玩吗。”王清雅对于这个必输的局，却是不想看下去了。
“不嘛，清雅姐，我要先看看别人怎么玩。”自从进入高中之后，李青青就一直是住校生，很少可以接触到英雄联盟这款游戏，所以一直听闻英雄联盟这游戏怎么怎么好玩，怎么有影响力，一直想玩玩看。
但是由于她在家长面前一直扮演着乖乖女的角色，基本不会接触游戏。
等到大学的时候，家长已经对她管的不怎么严了，毕竟已经长大成人了，要给孩子一些空间，所以李青青就撑不住内心的愿望了。
一到大学就想玩玩那款被称为最有影响力的游戏，英雄联盟。
所以一进入网吧，李青青就想看看英雄联盟这游戏到底怎么样。
王清雅听后，无奈，只得陪着她。
不过当她看见，对方竟然用瑞雯竟然可以把潘森压出经验区，则是有些震惊。
要知道她玩瑞雯的时候，最讨厌的就是对方的潘森，每次都被对方打爆，没有一次例外的。

“好像他玩的瑞雯，伤害好像有点不正常的高啊。”看着对方的两段折翼之舞，并没有发现夹杂其中的普攻，王清雅有些惊奇。
不过当王清雅看到瑞雯的控兵技巧后，却是非常的震撼。
“这……好厉害的控兵技巧。”不可否认，王清雅这一刻真正的被震慑住了，在蓝色方小兵的能量将要击杀掉紫色方小兵的时候，一记普攻收下。
可以说这样的控兵技巧，基本兵线不会向前推过去，而兵线推不过去，紫色方的潘森就吃不到经验，这样一来瑞雯就可以死死的压制住潘森。
只要打野不来抓，基本上潘森就废了。
“这个人，好厉害。”王清雅看着眼前人的一头黑发，默默惊叹道。
……………
“等我偷完他们家的蓝BUFF，就去支援你，你找个机会速度到两级。”
潘森听到盲僧话精神一震，只不过看着前方瑞雯死死的控住兵线，想要升到两级的话，就得向前。
看着自己磕了血瓶，有些恢复的血量，潘森心中有了些底气，瑞雯才两级应该是秒不掉自己的。
随后潘森进了草丛，想要靠着草丛的隐蔽性偷吃经验。
苏环见了，心中暗笑，看着自己的经验，还差一个小兵就三级了。
心中微微有了计划，随后看着自己眼前的有半血多紫色小兵，一记普攻，直接打残。
随后便不理，而是往草丛内赶去，而苏环的守卫图腾已经冷却完毕了，但是他刚刚注意到对面盲僧在中路Gank了一波，虽然没有击杀掉，但是也逼出了发条的一个闪现。
而他发现盲僧脚下是有蓝红BUFF的，也就是说第一个蓝色方的红BUFF，他并没有让给伊泽瑞尔。
那么现在盲僧估计在偷己方的蓝BUFF，只要自己现在击杀掉潘森，盲僧肯定会放弃上路Gank，而跑去打红BUFF，到时候这个眼就有着很重要的侦查作用了。
接近了草丛后，苏环一个勇往直前，直接冲进了草里，一进来便发现躲在草里想蹭经验了潘森。
一记普攻打出，随后瞬间接上第一段折翼之舞，取消了普攻的后摇，同一时间又是一记普攻，随后点燃套上。
潘森见瑞雯冲进草丛后，被套上了点燃，对方这是要直接拿下他的人头啊。不由得十分气愤，然而他没有任何办法，当务之急是迅速升到两级。
只要升到两级，下一次就配合打野抓死你，潘森恶狠狠道。

随后潘森迅速一标长矛投掷，直接扎死了一名小兵。
但是他看着经验条，还差一个小兵才升级。
看着距离自己只有几步的蓝色方残血小兵，就想上前补掉。
但是这个时候他的血量已经接近死血了。
随后潘森瞳孔猛然一缩，他看见了瑞雯一瞬间升级了。
怎么回事，怎么那么快又升一级了。
原来那个被苏环打残的小兵，已经被蓝色方的小兵击杀掉了，所以苏环的瑞雯一瞬间便升到了三级。
苏环迅速的使用快捷键把技能点在震魂怒吼上点上，点亮了技能。
毫不犹豫的使用出了震魂怒吼，一瞬间潘森又被晕眩住了。
一记普攻下去，又是掉落了一小截血量，潘森的血量已经是死血了，只要再被普攻两下，基本就死了。
从晕眩中苏醒的潘森，又向前走了一步。
近了近了，只要再走一步，就可以A死那只小兵了。
现在的潘森已经忘记了盲僧是让自己升到两级配合他，抓死瑞雯。而不是要他付出生命的代价，来升到两级。
不过显然潘森现在已经顾不了那么多了。
但是苏环怎么会让其如意，眼中凌厉之色一闪，第三段折翼之舞激活，随后狠狠劈下，一瞬间便把潘森给击飞了起来。
随后瞬间接下一记普攻，带走了潘森的人头。
“FirstBlood（第一滴血）”
至死潘森都没有升到两级。

Chapter 5 Pan Sen’s Two Levels of Resentment
The author woke up early in the morning and found that his virginity seemed to have been broken.
Thanks to book friend 110501153050989 (please call me Brother Kaishui), I will inevitably leave a scar, and I will give you the reward. This is the first time for the author, \(^o^)/~
College of Science and Technology, in the girls dormitory.
"Sister Qingya, please hurry up." At the door of the dormitory, a very beautiful girl with an oval face, some baby fat, shouted towards the door.
"We're coming soon, Qingqing, please wait a moment." A clear and sweet voice came from inside the door.
"Immediately, immediately, so many immediately." After hearing this, Li Qingqing muttered.
"Come on, come on, why are you in such a hurry?" Wang Qingya seemed to hear Li Qingqing's little complaint, and pinched her cute face with a little baby fat with a slight smile.
"Stop pinching, it will make it fatter if you pinch it any more. And you promised that you would teach me how to play League of Legends today, but don't think I'm stupid."
"Can't we teach in the dormitory? There are computers anyway, and the Internet cafe is so smoky and unclean." Wang Qingya rubbed her head helplessly, and she really didn't understand why her best friend had to go to the Internet cafe to play.
"It was said on the forum that playing League of Legends in an Internet cafe has more atmosphere and excitement. Let's go." Li Qingqing looked at Wang Qingya with big innocent eyes, holding her arm and coquettishly saying.
After Wang Qingya heard his snoring, she couldn't bear it.
"Okay, okay, let's go, but there are so many Internet cafes outside, which one should we go to?"
"Hey, I've done my research. The environment in the Internet cafe is the best and it's cheap. It's a newly opened Internet cafe. Let's go to the Internet cafe."
Wang Qingya couldn't resist her, so she had to answer.
As soon as he arrived at the fully powered Internet cafe, Li Qingqing started to yell a little.
"Qingya, look there's someone playing League of Legends over there."
Wang Qingya was speechless when she heard this.
If she were a man, she would probably be cursing by now.
Isn’t this nonsense? League of Legends is now the largest e-sports game in the world. Basically, people in Internet cafes play League of Legends, and it is extremely rare to see others playing other games.
But she also knew that her best friend was indeed a bit simple-minded. Although she was a bit arrogant at ordinary times, she was extremely cute.
Seeing that Li Qingqing had already run behind the opponent to watch, Wang Qingya had no choice but to follow.
Taking a closer look, the opponent was using a top laner named Ruiwen, but it was Wang Qingya's favorite top laner.
It's just that something is wrong with the other party. Before the game has started, we have already started to quarrel.
Wang Qingya's eyes felt disgusted when she saw the words "Orders on the fifth floor, if you don't give it, it will be given away".
She has met quite a few people like this, but basically none of them are good at playing, and they often just want to make twenty shots whenever they are at a disadvantage.
Then Wang Qingya discovered that the Japanese girl on the blue side seemed to have also fallen.
In other words, the players on the blue side will face a 3V5 situation.
"Sister Qingya, do you think he can win?" Li Qingqing asked with some confusion.
"Probably...can't. After all, it's a three-on-five situation, and it's hard to win like this." Wang Qingya hesitated slightly, but said in a low voice.
After all, it is very bad to talk about him in front of others.
"Qingqing, let's go. Don't you want me to teach you how to play?" Wang Qingya didn't want to watch this losing game anymore.
"No, Sister Qingya, I want to see how others play first." Since entering high school, Li Qingqing has been a dormitory student and has rarely been exposed to the game League of Legends, so she has always heard about how fun and influential the game League of Legends is, and she has always wanted to play it.
But because she has always played the role of a good girl in front of her parents, she basically has no exposure to games.
Wait until college, the parents are no longer very strict with her. After all, she has grown up and needs to give her children some space, so Li Qingqing can't hold back her inner wishes.
As soon as I arrived at college, I wanted to play the most influential game, League of Legends.
So as soon as he entered the Internet cafe, Li Qingqing wanted to see what the game League of Legends was like.
After Wang Qingya heard this, she had no choice but to accompany her.
But when she saw that the other party could use Riven to push Pan Sen out of the experience zone, she was a little shocked.
You must know that when she played with Riven, what she hated the most was the opponent's Pan Sen. He was beaten to death by the opponent every time without exception.
"It seems that the damage he played with Ruiwen is a bit abnormally high." Wang Qingya was a little surprised when she saw the opponent's two dances of broken wings and found no basic attacks mixed in.
But when Wang Qingya saw Ruiwen's troop control skills, she was very shocked.
"This... is such an amazing troop control skill." It is undeniable that Wang Qingya was really shocked at this moment. When the energy of the blue minion was about to kill the purple minion, he stopped it with a basic attack.
It can be said that with this kind of troop control technique, the basic troop line will not be pushed forward. If the troop line cannot be pushed forward, Pan Sen on the purple side will not gain experience. In this way, Riven can suppress Pan Sen to death.
As long as the jungler doesn't come to catch him, Panson will basically be useless.
"This man is so powerful." Wang Qingya looked at the black hair of the person in front of her and silently exclaimed.
……………
"After I finish stealing their blue BUFF, I will support you. Find an opportunity to increase your speed to level 2."
Pan Sen was shocked when he heard the blind monk's words, but he saw Riven in front of him firmly controlling the line of troops. If he wanted to reach two levels, he had to move forward.
Seeing that he had knocked down the blood bottle and recovered some of his blood, Pan Sen felt confident that Riwen should not be able to lose him in just two seconds.
Then Pan Sen entered the grass, trying to steal experience by relying on the grass's concealment.
When Su Huan saw it, he smiled secretly in his heart. Looking at his experience, he was still one soldier away from reaching level three.
He had a plan in his mind, and then he looked at the purple soldier with half health in front of him, and he disabled it with a basic attack.
Then he ignored it and rushed into the grass. Su Huan's guard totem had already cooled down, but he just noticed the blind monk on the opposite side ganking in the middle. Although he didn't kill him, he still forced a flash of the clockwork.
And he discovered that there were blue and red BUFFs at the feet of the blind monk, which meant that he did not give up the red BUFF on the first blue side to Ezreal.
So now the blind monk is probably stealing his own blue buff. As long as he kills Panson now, the blind monk will definitely give up the top lane gank and run to hit the red buff. By then, this ward will play a very important role in detection.
After approaching the grass, Su Huan walked forward bravely and rushed directly into the grass. As soon as he entered, he found Pan Sen hiding in the grass trying to gain experience.
A basic attack was launched, and then the first dance of broken wings was instantly followed, canceling the back swing of the basic attack. At the same time, there was another basic attack, and then it was ignited and put on.
After Pan Sen saw Ruiwen rushing into the grass, he was lassoed and set on fire. The opponent was going to take his head directly. He couldn't help but feel very angry, but he had no choice but to quickly upgrade to level two.
As long as you get to level two, I will cooperate with the jungler to catch you to death next time, Pan Sen said fiercely.
Then Pan Sen quickly threw a spear, directly killing a soldier.
But he looked at the experience bar and saw that there was still one soldier left to level up.
Looking at the blue soldier with residual health only a few steps away from him, he wanted to step forward and kill him.
But at this time, his blood volume was close to death blood.
Then Pan Sen's pupils suddenly shrank, and he saw Riven's level up in an instant.
What's going on? Why did you get promoted to another level so quickly?
It turns out that the one who was suedThe minions that Huan defeated had been killed by the blue side's minions, so Su Huan's Ruiwen was promoted to level three in an instant.
Su Huan quickly used the shortcut keys to click on the skill on Soul-shaking Roar, lighting up the skill.
Without hesitation, he used the soul-shaking roar, and Panson was stunned again for a moment.
After one basic attack, another small amount of blood was lost. Panson's health was already dead. As long as he was attacked twice more, he would basically be dead.
Pan Sen woke up from his dizziness and took another step forward.
It's so close. Just take one more step and you can kill that little soldier.
Now Pan Sen has forgotten that the blind monk asked him to rise to level two to cooperate with him and catch Riwen to death. Instead of asking him to pay the price of his life to rise to two levels.
But obviously Pan Sen can't care about that much now.
But how could Su Huan let him get what he wanted? A sharp look flashed in his eyes, and he activated the third dance of broken wings, and then slashed down hard, knocking Pan Sen flying in an instant.
Then he immediately received a basic attack and took away Pan Sen's head.
"FirstBlood"
Even until his death, Pan Sen had not reached level two.
